## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] Refactor / internal
- [ ] Tests / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change
- [ ] Updated `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) if behavior/config changed
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (Node built-ins + `fetch` only)
- [ ] No secrets are logged or persisted anywhere new
